rationale: Improve-loop baseline: the kept Part C agent (prompt change + harness change), rerun with --search as the skill's setup requires.

Every baseline failure (e-001, e-015, 3 runs of e-012, 1 of e-013) asked the user for an order id instead of searching; added a Tool guidance rule to look the order up with find_order/list_my_orders first and ask only when the lookup finds no match or several equally likely ones.
e-006 (target mode): find_order('stationery') found nothing and the agent asked the user; added a rule to call list_my_orders before asking when find_order finds no match.

e-006 (target mode): the agent promised to escalate in an earlier message of the same turn, then ended on a question; the escalation check read only the last model response. Made it read every assistant message since the user's last message plus the draft.
Paired rerun requested by the student before Part E: second sample of candidate A (loop-1 agent, identical to baf8aa1), because single runs differ by about one case.
Paired rerun requested by the student before Part E: second sample of candidate B (loop-3 agent, identical to eb7d7ad), the change the keep rule reverted on a write_pass_5 drop.
